identity.title: Bot identity
identity.description: Customize the bot's nickname and avatar in {guild}. It only changes on this server; others keep the default.
identity.resetConfirmDescription: The bot goes back to the default nickname and avatar on this server.
identity.lockDescription: Customizing the bot's nickname and avatar on this server is a PRO feature.
identity.botNotInGuild: Bot is not on the server yet
identity.nicknameHelp: Max {max} characters. Empty = removes the custom nickname.
identity.avatarHelp: PNG/JPG/WebP/GIF. Automatically compressed up to {size}×{size}px, PNG.
identity.previewHelp: This is how the bot will appear in the member list and when it posts messages on this server.

color.label: Default Embed color
color.description: Applies to every bot message on this server: store menu, ticket card, poll, sale confirmation. Where a screen has its own color (a project column's color, a message highlight in the editor), the specific one wins. Empty uses the default green.
color.fixedColors: Success green, error red and warning yellow don't change: there the color is the information, not decoration.

token.title: Your own bot for direct messages
token.description: With your own bot configured, every direct message from this server is sent through it, with its name and picture, and using its sending limits.
token.dedicatedTitle: Use a bot dedicated to this dashboard
token.dedicatedInteractions: When you save, we start receiving this application's interactions. If you use this same bot for something else, its buttons and commands there will stop working.
token.dedicatedLiability: Most importantly: messages are now sent from {yours} bot account. Any Discord penalty for excessive sending falls on it, not on ours.
token.label: Bot token
token.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new token to replace it
token.help: Developer Portal → your application → Bot → Reset Token. The token is stored encrypted and is never shown back.
token.connected: Bot connected. Direct messages from this server are now sent through it.
token.savedNeedsInvite: Token saved. You still need to invite the bot to the server.
token.recheckReady: All set, the bot is ready.
token.recheckNotInGuild: The bot is not on the server yet.
token.recheckRejected: The token is still being rejected.
token.removeConfirmDescription: Direct messages go back to being sent by the platform bot, and mass DM stops working on this server until you configure a bot again.

status.inGuildFail: Bot is not on this server yet
status.massDmFail: Mass DM paused until the items above are resolved
status.invite: Invite the bot to this server
status.shared: This same bot serves {count} of your servers. Removing it here doesn't affect the others.
